context_scope: Exploratory known inputs: selection original case1, previously inspected camera case13 and background case21; not a new held-out evaluation
model_execution: Original BF16 checkpoint throughout; diagnostic side computations never replace model outputs or parameters
row_sampling: Deterministic uniformly spaced row indices, same rows for all candidate transforms and quantizers
activation_scalar_scope: All elements of each target Linear input on the BF16 trajectory
activation_channel_scope: Full per-channel summaries only for selected six modules; all other modules retain scalar summaries
snapshot_scope: First selected-module call per case/config/actual scheduler stage and requested step
snapshot_pool: 2D nonoverlapping block absmax to at most64x64, retained original shape and bin boundaries; not element-level images
selected_rule: From alpha0.5: Action largest VQ/Scalar RMSE ratio, largest VQ normalized RMSE, median-ratio representative; Video largest and smallest ratio; root proprio. Deduplicate and fill deterministically.
weight_reference: Stored full-run transforms with original BF16 model weights; decode existing packed scalar/VQ banks; no fitting
local_error_decomposition: eA=(QZ-Z)B^T, eW=Z(Bhat-B)^T, eCross=(QZ-Z)(Bhat-B)^T; FP32 with TF32 disabled; denominator ||ZB^T||F
stage_scope: Actual scheduler tags, video/action steps0..9; conditioning is separately tagged with step-1; call_index is not step
output_figures: row amplitude vs relative weight error
